About Me

I'm Khaidar Sinaan As Shidqii, based in Wonosobo, Indonesia. My main focus is video editing — turning raw footage into content with clean rhythm, transitions, and visual effects, using CapCut and Alight Motion as my main tools.

Beyond editing, I also have basic web development skills to build simple pages like this portfolio.

Open to collaborating on video editing projects, whether for social media content, promotions, or personal needs.
